description: Programs for counting graceful permutations of the path graph P_n (OEIS A006967): adam2_v3.cpp, an Adamaszek-style layered dynamic-programming counter that can also restore the endpoint-resolved counts G(n; a, b) from its final layer, and graceful_enum.c / graceful_enum_shard.c, an independent complete enumeration used as a cross-check for small n. Written for the research note 'Conjecture: 8 | G(n) for every n >= 5, checked for all n <= 71' (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23634015) and the technical note 'Endpoint structure of graceful permutations of paths' (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23802065). The programs were written with AI assistance.
title: adam2: counting graceful permutations of paths, with endpoint-resolved counts
